newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Friday that around 1,400 head were exported into the United States at two crossing points Thursday.
Through Presidio, Texas, around 1,200 head were sold at mostly steady prices compared to Wednesday. "Trade active, demand good, USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 92-102 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 82-92 cents/lb.
Through Laredo, Texas, around 200 head were sold, although not enough to establish trend or quote prices.
